mass servers for november: saturday 7.30pm: team f: matilda thompson, kyle kilbane, ellie higgins, sophie coen, ana clara gracia, amela crean. sunday 10am: team emily luke marigliano, natalie dosek, tjasa barcanec, fabian zborowski, leighanna burke. cemetery prayers: prayers for all our deceased loved ones will be said this sunday 1st november at 2.30pm in the friary cemetery and at 3pm in the parish cemetery. altar list of the deceased : in november, we remember all our faithful departed, with all saints’ day on 1st nov. and all souls’ day on 2nd nov. marking the beginning of this special time of remembrance. envelopes are now available in the church porch, where you can include the names of your deceased family members and friends for the november altar list. all included will be prayed for during our daily masses throughout the month. the envelopes and enclosed lists can be returned to the box near the sacristy. november remembrance mass: the annual remembrance mass will take place on saturday 21st november at 7.30pm. we will remember in a special way parishioners who have died during the past year, as well as praying for all whose names are included in the november altar lists. mass for bereaved parents & their families takes place in st. john’s rest & care centre, knock next sunday 8th november at 3pm. chief celebrant is fr. vincent sherlock. a candle will be lit in memory of each person as their name is called aloud. all welcome. november mini-vigil for the holy souls takes place in the parish church, knock shrine next friday 6th nov. from 9pm to midnight. confessions available from 8pm to 9pm in the chapel of reconciliation. bereavement support group meets at the family centre, knock shrine every wednesday morning at 11am. no booking required, all welcome. for further information, contact
